analysis: The PR changes only documentation: docs/developer/build.md and docs/developer/test.md. It bumps the 'Last updated' dates to 2026-10-31 and expands the CI runner routing text. The new text says each provider shard reads its own lane (`test-provider-1` to `test-provider-5`), that a lane is granted whole or not at all, and that the test coverage pins one lane per matrix shard. No provider runtime code, protocol, crypto, attestation, key handling or trust-boundary logic is touched, so none of TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-009, TB-011 or the related A-/T- entries are affected. The docs describe CI routing to Darkbloom Sandboxes for read-only jobs. The stated safeguards are a default-off switch, no token permissions or checkout for the route job, fork PRs keeping the fallback, exact label-match grants, and release, signing and publication jobs on literal Blacksmith labels. The new text leaves these unchanged and does not widen them. Residual question for later review: the actual workflow changes (.github/workflows/ci.yml and darkbloom-route.yml) are not in this batch. Whether per-shard lanes keep least-privilege and release-isolation properties depends on that code, which I could not examine. This is a limit on coverage, not evidence of a regression, and the docs make no new security claims.
